messages:
sam_cs: heads up — Acme reported invoice shows ~18k extra tokens compared to dashboard for March close. Seen after last-night backfill.

devin_support: got it. are they on PAYG or committed? @ingrid_finance?

ingrid_finance: Acme is committed monthly. Pulled invoice inv_2026_03_acme — delta is +18,432 tokens on the 'standard-text' line.

sam_cs: dashboard snapshot at 2026-03-31 23:59 UTC shows 241,112 tokens; invoice total is 259,544. Backfill job ran 2026-04-01 01:12 UTC (post-cutoff).

eli_infra: confirmed — the backfill reprocessed a missing shard and wrote rows with event_ingest_ts in March but processed_at in April. Our billing pipeline currently prefers processed_at for billing_date.

marta_sre: logs from billing-backfill-run-2026-04-01.log: `INFO batch_id=7782 committed tokens=18432 target_partition=2026-03-31`. There's an ambiguous mapping in the ingestion->billing stage.

sam_cs: customer wants an explanation + credit if those tokens shouldn't count in March. Suggested immediate plan: (1) verify whether invoice used processed_at vs event_ingest_ts; (2) if billed to March incorrectly, issue a corrective credit; (3) patch backfill to bucket by event_ingest_ts going forward.

devin_support: repro I'm running now. SQL to reproduce dashboard count (using event date):

```
SELECT sum(tokens) FROM usage_events
WHERE customer_id='acme' AND event_ingest_date BETWEEN '2026-03-01' AND '2026-03-31';
```

This returns 241,112. The invoice query (billing_date) returns 259,544.

eli_infra: quick audit: the write path does `billing_date = COALESCE(processed_date, event_date)`; backfill populated processed_date only. That's the root cause. We'll flip priority to prefer event_date when present.

ingrid_finance: operationally — invoice already issued. If we move those rows to April we need to credit March. Is the standard here to post a negative line in April referencing March? @sam_cs

sam_cs: I'll propose a one-time manual adjustment equal to the delta and draft the customer note explaining it was a backfill timing artifact. If finance prefers, we can post an April credit with a March reference. Need direction quickly — customer is asking for same-day resolution.

marta_sre: created INFRA-1127 to change backfill billing_date behavior, added unit and integration tests. ETA for patch and deploy to prod: 24h.

eli_infra: patch merged to staging. Running a dry-run on a copy of March partition now to ensure no additional bucket shifts. Will post results shortly.

devin_support: attaching repro outputs (pasted above). Once finance confirms credit approach I'll share the customer-facing message.

billing-bot: automated note — invoice inv_2026_03_acme generated 2026-04-01T02:05Z, status: sent.

ingrid_finance: approve provisional credit. We'll post a negative line item in April referencing March and prepare the journal entry. Sam, send the draft email and cc finance.

sam_cs: sending draft now. thanks everyone. :thumbsup:
